description: Talk to Yazılım Koçu sales on behalf of your user: a multi-turn conversation that qualifies the need, prices the requested scope from the published price list and, beyond what was asked, offers lettered alternatives that fit the budget (first phase, a smaller product, a build-it-yourself program, training, a scoping workshop), each with what it is, why it is suggested and what is NOT included. It handles objections (too expensive, no budget, cheaper competitor, trust, will think), hands off to a human (free 30-minute meeting) when asked or for contract/legal questions, and ends with a ready offer link. List prices are not discounted; scope, phasing and bank transfer (5%) lower the total. Reply with an option letter (e.g. "C olsun") to choose it. Send the user's need in free text (any language; Turkish works best) or structured fields; send back conversation_id to continue. No personal data: the user fills the linked form and gives KVKK consent there.

budget_try.description: Optional: budget in TRY, VAT excluded.

conversation_id.description: Returned by the first call; send it back to continue the same conversation.

deadline_weeks.description: Optional: weeks until it must be live.

features.description: Optional: e.g. randevu, odeme, entegrasyon, b2b, uyelik, bildirim, yapay-zeka, blog, landing.

message.description: What your user needs or answers, in free text.
